name: Kuhipaat Testimonials
author: kuhipaatmarketplace

sections.description:
Kuhipaat Testimonials lets you add, design and display client testimonials anywhere on your WordPress site — without writing a single line of code.

Features

  • 3 layouts — Slider (Swiper.js carousel), Grid (equal columns), Masonry (Pinterest-style)
  • Star rating picker (1–5 stars with visual click interface)
  • Client photo upload with circular avatar display
  • Video testimonials — YouTube, Vimeo or direct MP4 URL
  • Testimonial categories — group by service, product or industry
  • Custom card background colour, text colour and border radius
  • 13 Google Fonts — Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, Lato, Poppins, Montserrat, Raleway, Nunito, Playfair Display, Merriweather, Source Serif 4, DM Sans, Josefin Sans
  • Card element order — drag and drop to reorder quote, text, stars, client info and video
  • Headline HTML tag selector — choose H1–H6 or P for SEO control
  • Slider navigation colours — arrow icon colour, arrow background colour and pagination dot colour
  • Autoplay speed control
  • SEO-friendly Schema.org (LocalBusiness + Review + AggregateRating) JSON-LD output
  • Compatible with Rank Math and Yoast SEO
  • Gutenberg block
  • Elementor widget
  • Divi Builder module
  • WordPress Widget
  • Unlimited testimonials per section
  • Unlimited published sections

Embed Methods

[testimonial_section id="123"]

Or use the Gutenberg block, Elementor widget, Divi Builder module or WordPress Widget — no shortcode needed.

External Libraries and Services

Swiper.js (MIT licence) powers the slider layout. It is bundled inside the plugin (assets/vendor/swiper/) and makes no external requests.

  • Source: https://github.com/nolimits4web/swiper
  • Licence: https://github.com/nolimits4web/swiper/blob/master/LICENSE

Google Fonts (optional). By default the plugin makes no external requests. Only if you choose a Google Font for a section, visitors’ browsers load that font’s stylesheet from fonts.googleapis.com on pages showing that section. This sends the visitor’s IP address and browser details to Google.

  • Service: Google Fonts – https://fonts.google.com
  • Terms of Service: https://developers.google.com/fonts/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Privacy

This plugin does not collect or store personal data and has no tracking, analytics or telemetry. The only external request is the optional Google Fonts stylesheet described above.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress admin go to Plugins → Add New, search for Kuhipaat Testimonials and click Install Now → Activate.
  2. The Testimonials menu will appear in your left sidebar.
  3. Go to Testimonials → Add New to add your first testimonial.
  4. Go to Testimonials → Sections → + New Section to build a section.
  5. Copy the shortcode and paste it into any page or post.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce or any other plugin?

No. It works with any WordPress theme and requires no other plugins.

Does it work with page builders?

Yes. Gutenberg block, Elementor widget, Divi Builder module and WordPress Widget are all included.

Does it output SEO schema markup?

Yes. Schema.org JSON-LD (LocalBusiness + Review + AggregateRating) is output automatically on every page where a testimonial section is shown. Compatible with Rank Math and Yoast SEO.

How do I change the slider arrow colour?

In the Section editor, scroll to Slider Options → Slider Navigation Colors and use the colour pickers for arrow icon colour, arrow background and pagination dot colour.

Can I use a custom font?

Yes. The plugin includes 13 Google Font options. Select your preferred font in the Section editor under Card Style → Google Font.

Where can I get support?

Post in the WordPress.org support forum or visit kuhipaat.in.
